newsitem.title: USA: Zaring Homes Inc says forming holding co.
newsitem.headline: Zaring Homes Inc says forming holding co.

text.p: Zaring Homes Inc said on Friday that its shareholders had voted to form a holding company named Zaring National Corp, of which Zaring Homes will become a subsidiary.
Under the plan, the current holders of Zaring Homes common shares will receive common shares of Zaring National, Zaring Homes said in a statement.
It added that Zaring National will continue to trade on the Nasdaq National Market under the stock symbol.
Zaring Homes, with regional divisions in Cincinnati, Nashville, Raleigh and Indianapolis, builds move-up homes.
